data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 热汤浴后
data.description: 温泉旅馆的私人风吕里弥漫着滚烫的水汽，雪乃整个人浸润在清澈的温泉中，黑亮的长发挽在脑后。被热水蒸透的白皙雪肤泛着诱人的粉色，她双手遮在胸前垂下眼帘——「温泉的温度似乎有点太高了……心跳一直快得停不下来。你、你不准靠得太近。」
data.lighting: soft warm bathroom light and steam
data.camera: medium shot, face, hands and waterline visible
data.promptProse: Adult Yukino sits immersed in the warm bath with her hair pinned up, both hands holding the wet white towel across her chest. She lowers her gaze through the steam beneath soft bathroom light.
data.animaCaption: Both hands hold the wet towel across her chest above the bathwater.
